name: Pattern Magic
body:
Awareness of mystic patterns allows you to wield magic in tune with the universe.

Prerequisite(s): Oc’cli; pattern recognition ability.

Benefit(s): You can use your pattern recognition ability to gain a bonus to concentration checks and caster levels checks made to penetrate Spell Resistance. If you use this ability you add your pattern recognition bonus to damage or healing caused by the spell being cast.
